name: novel_orfs
description: One row per novel ORF candidate (GIPPA_SPEC.md §7.6.6, §9.3; ADR-0012 decision 3).

fields.name: orf_id
fields.description: Novel ORF ID NOVEL_<contig>_<lowest 1-based coordinate of the longest interval>_<p|m>

fields.name: class
fields.description: Novel-ORF class (§7.6.1, ADR-0013)

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon ID

fields.name: strand
fields.description: Strand

fields.name: frame
fields.description: Reading frame (+1..+3, -1..-3)

fields.name: start_longest
fields.description: 1-based position of the first base of the most upstream start codon, in transcription direction (on '-' the highest coordinate, so start > end there; unlike other tables, not the lowest/highest pair); NA without a start codon

fields.name: start_best_ostir
fields.description: 1-based position of the first base of the start codon with the best OSTIR score, in transcription direction (on '-' the highest coordinate, so start > end there; unlike other tables, not the lowest/highest pair); NA without an OSTIR score

fields.name: end
fields.description: 1-based position of the last base of the stop codon (of the last whole codon when open at a linear end), in transcription direction (on '-' the highest coordinate, so start > end there; unlike other tables, not the lowest/highest pair)

fields.name: length_aa_longest
fields.description: Protein length (aa, stop excluded) from start_longest, or from the first peptide without a start codon

fields.name: length_aa_best
fields.description: Protein length (aa, stop excluded) from start_best_ostir, or from start_longest when it is NA

fields.name: start_codon_best
fields.description: Start codon at start_best_ostir (or start_longest when it is NA)

fields.name: n_peptides
fields.description: Distinct peptides (I/L folded) supporting the ORF

fields.name: peptides
fields.description: Supporting peptides, I/L folded (';'-separated list)

fields.name: best_peptide_q
fields.description: Lowest q-value of the supporting peptides

fields.name: ostir_tir
fields.description: OSTIR translation initiation rate at start_best_ostir

fields.name: promoter_score
fields.description: Best Promotech score upstream of the ORF (second round, M7-08)

fields.name: promoter_supported
fields.description: A promoter supports the ORF (ADR-0012)

fields.name: terminator_downstream
fields.description: A terminator lies downstream of the stop codon (ADR-0012)

fields.name: terminator_conf
fields.description: Confidence of that terminator (ADR-0012)

fields.name: terminator_distance_nt
fields.description: Distance from the stop codon to that terminator, nt (ADR-0012)

fields.name: rbs_supported
fields.description: The start has RBS support (OSTIR threshold)

fields.name: class_fdr
fields.description: Class-level FDR as a float (%.6g), or 'unestimated'

fields.name: called
fields.description: The ORF is called (§7.6.4)

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank among novel ORFs (M7-09); not the row order

fields.name: overlapping_gene
fields.description: Locus tag of the overlapped or extended gene

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined flags from the controlled vocabulary (§9.4); `denovo_only_unsupported`: every peptide is de novo, none is a database PSM, and there is no RBS support beyond the class rule (ADR-0050)
